title: dabbler view work-explorer (the Work Explorer's rows)
description: The whole Work Explorer tree as `dabbler view work-explorer` prints it: each repository it was given, its buckets, its sessions, and under a session its tasks, verification, findings and what needs attention. It is a read, not a record: nothing on disk is written in this shape. Every rule that decides a row -- its words, its icon, whether it starts open, which actions it offers and what each one runs -- is the router's, so an interface renders these rows and works none of them out again. Every level is present in the data, whatever starts collapsed on screen.

schemaVersion.description: The shape this payload is written in.

repositories.description: One row per repository given that has a sessions root, in the order given.

row.description: One row of the tree, and the rows beneath it.

id.description: Stable across refreshes and unique across the whole tree, so an interface keeps what was open and selected.

tooltip.description: Markdown source. A `$(name)` is an icon by name, as in the label.

collapsible.description: Whether the row has children, and whether it starts open. `expanded` is the In Progress bucket's alone.

contextValue.description: The row's tokens, each wrapped in `;`: its kind, its state, and one `act-` token per action it offers.

click.description: What activating the row does, or null where it does nothing.

actions.description: The actions the row offers, in menu order.

error.description: On a repository row whose progress reading failed: why, in words a person can act on. Such a row has no sessions.

icon.description: An icon by name. A `theme` icon is the editor's own glyph, optionally in a named theme colour; a `file` icon is one of the operator's status pictures, by its file name under media/light and media/dark.

action.description: One action, as an interface shows and runs it: the `dabbler` command it stands for with its arguments filled in, or the file it opens -- exactly one of the two -- and what it needs from a person first. Nothing about it is left for the interface to decide.

argv.description: The command, beginning `dabbler`, run in the repository's root.

preview.description: A command that writes nothing, whose output the person reads before they are asked: a rollback's dry run, an exception's card. A rollback's dry run prints JSON whose `head` is passed back as `--as-of`.

opens.description: A file an action opens rather than a verb it runs.

line.description: The line to open at, 1-based; null for the top.

fragment.description: The page's own anchor, for a page rather than a text file.

confirmation.description: A confirmation a person gives before the action runs, in the words they are shown.

detail.description: What the question means, or null where the words come from the action's preview instead.

keep.description: The button that keeps things as they are, or null where dismissing is the only way back.

reason.description: A reason a person types before the action runs. It reaches the command as `--reason <text>` after its other arguments, and dismissing the box aborts.

blank.description: What an empty answer passes, or null where an empty answer changes nothing because the reason is the authority itself.
